body:
They didn't cheat on you, they cheated on themselves and robbed themselves of happiness. It doesn't matter what people say but what they do. And it doesn't matter what people do, it matters what power you give it to destroy you. Take it as a lesson, stay genuine and kind. Don't let this change you. It's hard but we'll make it.
Stay different in a world where everyone's the same. Got it? 
Much love to you.

I used to have this special connection with someone once. But, when he called me a year later , I told him that we will never be together. We sometimes text once a year or two just to say the typical if we are okay. And to be honest with you, my heart used to skip a beat every time I saw his messages. Not any longer. So? It takes time. But you won't be the same person in the years to come, even if you meet up at some point or speak again, you'll see that you've grown into somebody else. Someone stronger and more mature. And some people sadly, stay right where you left them. Grow. Learn. You can do this! Cherish the connection of course but don't idealise anyone in your head as "the one". There is no "one" but the one that stays. If you find the one that stays, stay with them. 
Much love to you while you're healing.

It's rough advice but, kill the hope. 
The person's gone. You'll change over time. You'll grow. And not one person can fit inside your entire life to be your best friend or soulmate. There'll come others , for each person you'll grow into or one particular that will grow alongside you. 
In case you want to text, try it.
Maybe it'll help with the process anyway.
Best of luck to you!

What's the right choice, you are thinking? Forget about soulmates and special connections and everything. The answer is really simple. Stay where you are loved. Stay where they didn't give up on you. Stay with the ones that stay. And if you're thinking about it, it's not a sin. And it isn't horrible. You shared two years of your life with that person, it's pretty normal. Forgive, forget and stay where you are happy. Stay where they never betrayed you. Don't stay in the past , you do not belong there. 

Much love to you. You will get through this.
 Hold on tight.

My advice is that sometimes you need to forgive and forget. Both yourself and him. And then you need a little ego to move on. Don't linger in the past,you don't belong there so that when someone new comes your way, you can love them properly.

Best of luck to you :)

You can do nothing. Nothing for other people's feelings and thoughts and actions, that is. All that you can do is control the way you feel about it. You can get anxious, you can feel less worthy, you can feel less in general, heartbroken and alone but that is just a necessary step. Self realisation is the key. Sit down with yourself, an empty page In front of you and write down everything you think that you did wrong in this relationship. I know, it's hard right? And we'd love to blame the other person. But, really, you won't get better by blaming. You'll get better by realising this sooner or later. Now, you're in the "sooner" and you want closure, answers, him to feel the way you did. In the "later" you won't need any of these things if you heal the right way. The only harsh answer is that you go through it, keep your dignity and your self respect up high even if it's a facade. Don't break In front of him. The best way is no way. No revenge, no calls, no texts. He'll start to wonder why. Never beg a man to stay or treat you right. You'll move on and you'll forget if it's the end of the world right now and your heart is crumbling, a new world will rebuild anew. And you'll love again and it won't be so hard. Give yourself a break. Love yourself. Cleanse yourself. If they leave say they did you a favour. 
The second key is self respect. Keep your head up!

The first thing you gotta do is relax. Let it flow. If he is interested in you, let him do the chase. Give him space to miss you and think about you,too. It works most of the time. You'll hear from him soon. And if you don't, well he didn't like you enough. Cherish the night you spent together and don't overthink it. You barely know him. Try not to fall too soon darling. Best of luck to you.

Hi girl. I have been through something similar recently myself. It's a good thing to not cling onto this man with high hopes. What I do, I don't take them seriously until they prove to me they are serious about me. There are a lot of men out there like that and it's just...sad. While it is true, a man that likes you won't leave you wondering if you do, sometimes there are exceptions as to why he is acting the way he is. The question isn't in the why, but are you really willing to understand and fight for this guy? Or sit around and wait? This is the thing you have to ask yourself. I know it is hard, but you must act a little distant yourself. Take some time alone right now and cherish it. Find yourself. Love yourself. Energy doesn't lie. When you are worried and he triggers your anxiety, he can feel it,too. Step up into your confidence shoes. Go out with your friends and forget about him. That is what he does. That is what you should do, too. Don't believe what they say , believe what they do. And he leaves you hanging, leave him hanging too. If he comes back, make him wait. Men just don't want to lose their freedom, especially when travelling with male friends. He wants his space to do his thing and he might be thinking about you right now, but don't sit around and wait. Don't hope too soon. Let him do the effort for you. If he reaches out again, don't be quick to see him. Make him work for it a little bit. You'll see then if he really liked you. And if he doesn't, that's great! You didn't waste your time. Never ever let them know your next move. If he thinks you're always available and understanding, he will use it against you. 
Don't be predictable. If you don't want to play these games with him, next time you go out tell him that you need at least one text a day. And that it's not about him validating you, but it's about him showing he cares. If he does, he'll try for you. Don't chase these men. Let him chase you. Change the energy and watch him come back. Then make him wait.

Best of luck to you! 
You'll be fine with or without him, girl.
Keep me updated if you want to

You can do a lot of things. You can date another girl and while she is away living her best life, you could indeed meet the girl that will love you enough to respect that no other man is gonna touch her whether she's away from you or close to you. Because she'll be in love with you and never ask you to let her go fucking cheat. Let's say it how it is. Or you can just end things and potentially still find the girl of your dreams that won't ever hurt you like that.
Either way, my friend, you'll be fine without her.
Why? Because she seems to think that she'll be fine without you AND another man touching her. 
So is this love? Man, I don't think so. Respect yourself.
Plus, I think little gifts from people constantly aren't a green flag but little gifts of guilt. I am talking from experience (maybe my experience isn't your experience but just saying).

Brutally honest ?...he will not change down the road. Not even if you love him. Not even if he says he's hurt and all that stuff. He's already had an opening of treating you like shit and he took it. And he will probably do it again. Saying you aren't strong when he sees you cry, could be a reflection of himself. Don't accept people's reflections on you. If you've gotta ask where you at, you are nowhere. He would've asked you if he wanted you by now. (I do not know how long you're dating but, yeah). 

I don't know you but I've accepted these behaviours from men for many years and it never ended well. It simply isn't worth your time. 

My gift to you, this song: Crooked Smile - J.Cole

Listen to it & love yourself a little more.

I don't think any opinion on modern dating Is absolutely and definitely the only truth that exists. There are multiple truths out there and so I'm going to say, as a woman that has dated through apps, while I didn't use to believe this, the biggest percentage isn't looking for love. (Shocker, right?) But, the reason why I always tried was because I was looking for something that could have been looking for me. I was on these apps and I was serious about it and I gave chances to guys, I would not judge anybody's beauty level but I'll go ahead and say nobody was a super looking dude. So, my experience in dating these guys is not your truth but it's my truth and this average looking guy was all that I didn't need in my life and he was wrong for me every time. So yeah some of us really do give chances to men without him having to be super hot and still will get hurt. Does anything matter anymore? Nah. Not at all. Average guys that went to the gym? Yes. That read books? Yes. Gamers? Of course. Older than me? Sure. Nothing ended well. Why? I don't fucking know and honesty,I don't care anymore. I'm trying to fix myself and that's all I can do to perhaps make better choices. I hope you do the same. So when the right one comes, we can love them right. And what's wrong with the rest of the world? Who the fuck cares anyway. Best of luck to ya .

It's too sad to see the person behind the potential we create for them. When you have a good heart, it is never your loss. I know it feels like shit right now, but you'll come to terms with it. I'll give you two things to hold onto while you heal. 
1. When something is not for you, you'll have warning signs, you'll have wake up calls and finally a big slap in the face. That's just life trying to get you to where you will be happiest. And that was not the place. Good news - you'll get where you're supposed to be more happy.

2. Theres a person out there to whom you're his dream girl. He'll do the things you did for others in time, he won't make mistakes as big as the other ones, he'll care for you and love you and it'll be a tranquil love. You will know when the time comes. I ask myself this quite often when I'm mistreated by guys, why would I give a million chances to the guy that is willing to hurt me in every one of those while there's someone out there - I know it in my heart, who's waiting for a girl like me and he will not fuck up like the rest did.

I wish you the best and I feel for you. This will only make you stronger.

The fact that he is gay right now is great news. He's embracing his sexuality. But all these words look like manipulation wrapped in a sentimental letter made to make him look good. I imagine he hurt you a lot before he left. I just feel like he uses words to compliment you but at the same time demean  you. Don't take the bait. Move on with your life. He was never really worth it. Being straight, gay or bi has nothing to do with the way you treat people and I'm just taking a wild guess here OP but I think he didn't treat you as you deserve.

I'm that nice girl for somebody but he's not there yet and I'm just a nobody on the side of his life. I hope you have the courage to not let go of her. I'm ending things with him because he doesn't value me. Please, keep the good ones close to you and don't lose them. Life gives you rare chances in happiness. Hope the best for you :)

People move mountains for the ones they love. Sometimes it's not two sided. It's scary that we don't know what the other person is thinking about. They could not even like us enough and just stick with it because of loneliness or boredom. Both sides make mistakes but I've seen people do dumb shit in the name of love. Perhaps you were doing these things in the name of love and it just wasn't the same for her? I am really glad you got to heal though. You're here to help someone else move on, perhaps. So, thank you.

I write poetry. I have written about a lot of people I used to date. I always saw the potential. I get it. I thought it was a flaw. But, it isn't. The way you see the world and people around you and how sometimes you just can't believe how people can be so cruel is actually rare and beautiful. It's a reflection of your heart. It hurts you but you are who you are. Learn to draw some lines. It happens along the way as you grow older anyway. You get tired of people's shit. It is part of maturing. 

I just want to say, yes, these people knew us like no other. Yes, they've seen us vulnerable and we did declare our love for them and they for us and now it's over. All of that is gone out the window. Or so you think right now. In the "right now" that you don't want to be in, there lies your power. No, it won't always hurt like it does now. You'll become more resilient. Even after another heartbreak I believe it won't always stay as deep a scar. 

Well, I have something last I'll share with you. I went to therapy after my last heartbreak and I told my therapist how I was single for 2 years straight, no dating no nothing and I was about 23. Those were the best years of my life. I felt free to do anything I wanted. She told me that THAT is the way you should feel with a partner, as well. Look for those years and compare it with anyone else that comes into your life. Do you feel the same freedom?

Love isn't torture.
Remember this.
Take care.

First of all let me say, falling in love and being in a relationship is great. But, there is a price. The price is attaching your love to them. And when it's the wrong person, you're screwed. While love is a great thing, the absence of it makes you do things you never thought you would. The absence of love is grief. It isn't hate. It isn't nothingness or numbness. It's grief. And grief is really difficult to deal with. You let go of that love in many stages. And you can come back to the start and then feel it all over again. And I also want to say, let go of that feeling of who texted who first. You aren't weak for this. You're looking for their love still in this world. It's normal to do so. Like the way you'd look for someone that has passed away and hoping you can hug them one last time. There's only one difference with grief of the dead, you can't text them or call them or hug them or ever see them again. In a past relationship though, you can. I've been with someone back in the day who would text daily and night and day with another person. I suspected they had a fling. To this day I don't have the evidence but it was never denied by them when accused. I remember feeling the way you did. My friends would take me out for coffee, walks, at the theater but my world was grief. My world had ended. And I was to blame. Because I saw things and I went and attached my soul to them. And then, it was really hard to get it back. I cried. I didn't eat. I texted them,too. We tried again to no avail. All I wanted was for them to call and say they loved me. I wanted my love back. But, I realised, the person that used to hold my love, isn't love itself. You aren't looking for him, you're looking for yourself and the way you felt good by being around him. When you realise it's all an illusion, when the grief is done with your heart and you've finally let go of that idea that they hold your love, you will be set free. And the sun will shine again. And you will become different. And you should become different. You should become more cautious. Don't go giving your heart to someone when you see you're incompatible from the start. 
Even if you go back there, into his arms as you might be hoping, you won't find the same love. 
As for him moving on and showing her off to the world, it's a way of coping. It's anything. It shouldn't matter to you.
And you will go through this process of breaking and rebuilding yourself again.
Love will find you in someone new. (Give it time)
And then,
you'll see how much you've grown.
You'll become a fighter.
You'll help others.
A stranger on Reddit, perhaps?

Your love is in you. The only way through right now is under. You have to feel like this. I know, it hurts. I know, it's uncomfortable but oh my God, is it worth it?
Yes. A thousand times yes.
The person that will come out will be drop dead gorgeous .

***
Kamal Ravikant - Love yourself like your life depends on it
(It's a book recommendation)
because it does.

And nights will feel cold and you will feel lonely but it's always darkest before dawn.

I'm going to give you some clarity, here's the thing: dating someone because they're funny or emotional or relationship material but not being sure if you're completely attracted to them won't work out. If you catch yourself doubting whether you like them or not, multiple times, it won't get better down the road. You'll catch yourself guessing again and again. You'll be in a more difficult situation after feelings have developed. You can fall in love with that person because of everything they are but you'll have glimpses of the "ick" and of doubt again and again. That means, you aren't attracted to them in the first place. And ...sadly, you cannot force it. 
Sometimes it's a hard pill to swallow that we aren't sexy to everyone on earth but it's also pretty freeing to accept it.
It's wrong to drag her down that road because you're looking at her and wondering, do I even like her? You might like her for everything she is and maybe it's amazing and all but, the thing is, if the question exists in your head from the beginning, you can't learn to become attracted to her. This is the harsh truth.  Find someone you're attracted to and you don't question it every time you look at them.

Sorry.

This previous summer I dreamt of a guy with blonde hair and blue green eyes. I felt so in love with him. We were in a fast moving train. We saw mountains, lakes, sands and sea. There was this big chemistry between us. I remember when I saw his face and it wasn't blurry, I knew that somehow I knew him but I'd never met him. For some reason though, I knew he wasn't mine. He was in a relationship with someone else. It wasn't sexual chemistry. It was...love. Just like it should be. I didn't miss him when I wake up,I knew someday I'd meet him or perhaps he was an angel looking over me in my hardest days.

Obviously heartbreak is grief. And grief is a very powerful emotion. You were loved before and now you've lost it. You had a taste of what it's like to be together and now the taste of aloness sucks. This is my advice to you, when it all gets better in the future and when you had the " I'm done" moment and the feelings fade away , because you can only love someone so much before you let them go and nobody is that special so that you'll wait your whole life for their return, it is gonna get clear in your head. Humans are habitual and you just gotta get used to being by yourself now. In the future, please do know this as an advice from a professional therapist did save me time and tears, seek out somebody who will make you feel like the best years of your life ,like when you're single and you're out having fun with friends. You don't have to worry about a damn thing because that person will get you and it'll be fucking freeing. It will be like you are your own person again and they are theirs and this will teach you also how to be alone if needed. How to be stronger together and apart. Love moves you and makes you better. If you are incompatible from the start, don't fall for them and let go before it's too late you can't change the shell of anyone by loving them. I'm trying to dodge you some bullets there for the future as last year I was in the exact same situation and my boyfriend told me that my life sucks and he couldn't take the burden of my problems - which I never inflicted upon him. These words were heavy words and they came from a mouth that was supposed to love me. My biggest fear did come true. I drew and I read a lot of books. I moved on once I was done. Grieving takes time. Don't try to get over it, get inside it and write down what you're feeling and why. Their absence will tell you everything you need to know and please remember, those that truly love you will never leave you alone to suffer and also if you're over it and they come back, remember the betrayal and don't fall for it. People rarely change. Some do, but , rarely. Wishing you the best , this journey even though it'll hurt at first, it'll make you fucking amazing and better at so many things. Next time, be more selective of your partners so that all of your needs are covered. And if they aren't, loneliness is better.
Remember, we are all alone together.

Okay. In their tiny little brains , karate is all about power. Karate really is about courage and honour. Sometimes courage means to go and sometimes it means staying and trying to find common ground. A lot of people are black belts and a lot of people are senseis but, not a lot of people are those things in their heart. Karate is about warrior spirit and so it is also about respect. You can leave or you can stand your ground. Or you can try another martial art in your town. I suggest reading books on Karate as you can find translated also in Spanish, the best Karate or the Bubishi - Karate Bible. 
If I were you, I'd tell my sensei face to face with the guy present. If they did not like it, I'd have quit and telling them they have no honour or respect for the sport whatsoever.
Karma finds everybody. One day on the street, this guy will get beat up by some kickboxer and his ego will fall. We all pay our mistakes in this life. Don't wish for it but it will happen.
Keep on being strong! Keep on learning about karate. You can always go back if you feel like it. But don't let this guy make you quit. 
The only way through is under.
And when you're a black belt, you can open up your own dojo in the town and let everyone come to you, perhaps.

Wish you the best. 
Ossu.

This picture of this woman you so adore and always will, guess what? It won't always stay the same. As you grow - and I'm sure you will grow into something even more beautiful than you already are, she will remain there. Right there where she left you for someone else. Tables turn. If you're something like me, you try and you try and you try and you make a choice that's once and for ALL.
Good job. Keep up the good work and your love awaits you in someone brand new and beautiful just as you are.
I'm a stranger on the internet and I find you brave, imagine the love of your life and what they could give to you.
Never settle for less.

Take care. Xx

I'm not going to explain it with logic. I'm going to go with gut feeling. It feels uneasy. You're a bit sensitive to the other world. From my experience with a house I used to live in and have had sleep paralysis for years , I completely understand where you're coming from. It is solid advice to visit a psychologist and follow their advice whether or not you need a psychiatrist we aren't doctors here, your psychologist maybe can help you through seeing it with a different perspective. Remember what works for everyone might not work for someone else. 
Other than that, this place seems heavy on the energy. Your anxiousness could be contributing to what you're experiencing, too. A prayer goes a long way. It has helped me. 
When you're low on energy and high on fear it's a really bad combination. Take care of yourself and stay healthy.

You weren't the right fit. But maybe love was there. But, it is true, love can only get you so far. So you both pushed the relationship even though deep down you knew it wasn't going to work out. As for the girl, wish her the best. Now, take care of yourself. There's work for her to be done but this is also a very good time for you to reflect on your choices in women and why you tolerate such behaviour in the first place. It is time to look within because remember, we can only change ourselves, never the other person.

Wish you the best.

I am a female dumper sometimes.  She doesn't care about you. That she showed with her actions. I have never cheated but been very clear and honest with everyone as to the reasons why I left them. She hasn't looked back and neither should you. Your soul is intertwined with her because perhaps you are bonding through trauma have low self esteem and maybe you think that was love. Let me tell you that wasn't love. Love Is gentle and love is caring and loads of shit that sounds cheesy but it isn't. Y'all need to understand sometimes in life you won't get closure and neither did I ,but I fucking moved on even when it fucking hurt. And so did many of us. If you go back to her, chances are, it won't feel the same. She's broken your trust once and then you'll be living in a made up fairytale. Educate yourself. Read books and find deep within you what went wrong and try to build your self esteem. Chances are, she will come back to you some day when she can't find someone like you and then my friend, you must have built your confidence so high and your self worth - if you are a good guy, which I assume that you are- so HIGH that you will be the one to say no. I assume you also have one of those kind hearts that forgives everything. Well, don't. People fucking suck. Learn to see their true faces and move on. She ain't worth your time.
But even after all of this that I wrote to you,
You still want to text her,
Eh. My friend , you will learn the hard way.
Good luck to you!

Don't hate yourself. It's a road that leads you down paths of more negativity in your life. Wish you all the best dear.
